newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIA C.BANK SELLS HRK 118 MLN BILLS, RATES SAME.
newsitem.headline: CROATIA C.BANK SELLS HRK 118 MLN BILLS, RATES SAME.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 118 million kuna in 35-day liquidity bills at a primary auction on Wednesday, compared to last week's 252 million kuna.
Volume shrank after banks which take part in the auctions had to allot more money for statutory reserves due to an increase in their deposits.
They reinvested 91 million kuna upon expiry and increased subscriptions by another 27 million, a central bank official said.
The bank currently has 1.5 billion in outstanding 35-, 91- and 182-day liquidity bills, an official said.
